title: Best Cricket Bats for Beginners in India (2026)
summary: Plain guide to 3 cricket bats for beginners in India: tennis ball, Kashmir willow and English willow. Not hand-tested; based on shop pages.
description: Three cricket bats for beginners in India, from tennis ball to English willow. Based on shop pages, not hand-tested. Check before you buy.
lead: Which cricket bat should a beginner buy in India? It depends on the ball. This guide gives three picks: a tennis-ball bat for gully cricket, a Kashmir willow bat for a first leather-ball bat, and an English willow bat for a serious beginner. We have not hand-tested any of them. We read the Decathlon India pages, and we say what those pages do not tell you.

picks.name: Decathlon Adult Kashmir Poplar Wood Cricket Bat T900 Power, size SH (tennis ball)
picks.label: Suits first-timers (tennis ball only)
picks.verdict: A simple tennis-ball bat from a large retailer, with a clear return and warranty offer. The page leaves out weight and stock.
paragraphs: The T900 Power is a tennis-ball bat in adult size SH (short handle, the usual adult size). The Decathlon India page names the wood as Kashmir poplar. The page shows a 2-year warranty and 30-day returns. It also showed about 3.8 out of 5 from 65 reviews when we opened it.

Here is what to know. The page does not give weight or length. We could not read the review text, so we cannot say what buyers like or dislike. The page also did not show a stock status, and we could not confirm it is on Amazon.in or Flipkart. It is a tennis-ball bat, so do not use it with a leather ball. If you can, hold it in a store first.

choose.heading: Match the bat to the ball
choose.text: Tennis-ball bats are not built for leather balls. The Decathlon tennis-ball bat in this guide is listed as Kashmir poplar. Pick the bat for the ball you will actually play with.

choose.heading: Kashmir willow or English willow
choose.text: Kashmir willow is the common lower-cost wood for leather-ball bats in India. English willow is generally lighter and has a bigger sweet spot, but it needs more care.

choose.heading: Understand grades
choose.text: English willow bats come in grades. G1 is usually the top grade, with more straight grains and fewer marks. Decathlon's range runs from G5 to G1. Grades differ by brand, so compare grain count and weight on each listing.

choose.heading: Check size and weight
choose.text: Choose size by player height. Shorter players usually need junior sizes like 5 or 6, and adults commonly use SH. Look for the weight in grams on the listing. None of the three Decathlon pages we opened gives a weight, so ask the seller or check in a store.

choose.heading: Plan for knocking-in and oiling
choose.text: Shops and makers advise oiling and knocking-in an English willow bat before real use. Some shops offer this as a paid service. Do not skip it.

choose.heading: Read returns, warranty and the box
choose.text: The three Decathlon India pages we opened show 30-day returns and a 2-year warranty. Small sellers often have shorter or conditional return windows. Also check for a cover and grip. Before you buy, make sure the page opens and shows stock.

faq.q: Can I use a tennis-ball bat with a leather ball?
faq.a: No. Tennis-ball bats are not made for leather balls. Use a leather-ball bat for a leather ball.

faq.q: Is Kashmir willow or English willow better for a beginner?
faq.a: Kashmir willow is the usual lower-cost choice for a first leather-ball bat. English willow is generally lighter with a bigger sweet spot, but it needs oiling, knocking-in and more care. Start with Kashmir willow unless you will play often.

faq.q: What size cricket bat should I buy?
faq.a: Go by height. Adults commonly use SH. Shorter players usually need junior sizes like 5 or 6. Check the size chart on the product page, and try the bat in a store if you can.

faq.q: Do I need to knock in a new bat?
faq.a: Shops and makers advise oiling and knocking-in an English willow bat before real use. Some shops do it for a fee. The Decathlon pages we opened do not say if their bats come prepared, so ask before you buy.
